race.comment: THERE GOES MY HERO (4) returns after a six-month spell. Raced at this track four times last prep and as competitive on each occasion. Finished fourth in a recent trial here and should be ready to make an immediate impact. Stablemate BROADWAY DANCER (9) last appeared 11 months ago when successful over 1400m at Balaklava under the care of Stephen Theodore. Beautifully in at the weights and should come to hand very quickly. MY MATE SONNY (1) is back after a 20-week lay-off. Unplaced here at this trip first-up last prep then stepped up in distance and won two straight, both times at Port Lincoln. Might be better for this run but cannot be ruled out entirely. CHARKA (10) drops 4.5kgs off a failure over 1000m at Murray Bridge 25 days ago. Very fit now and from gate one gets all the favours. TALENT SCOUT (5) failed first-up at Morphettville by will find this many lengths easier.
